name: Maintenance Tunnel
narrativeOnEnter: Narrow stone passage. Old pipes overhead. Light at the far end — outside.

hotspots.label: Exit Hatch — Open Air
hotspots.lockedMessage: A rusted combination lock holds the hatch bar in place. Four digits. Someone set this lock before they left.

action.text:
Carved into the hatch frame:

'She set the lock before she left.
Two numbers, back to back.

First: her patient number (two digits).
Second: how many patients were mapped in total.

— A.C.'

Behind a pipe: a cloth bag with a list. 47 names — all Ward B patients.
Voss's name at the top, underlined twice.

Scratched into the wall: 'Dr. Elara Voss — not Patient 07. AXIOM mapped all 47 of us. They built something called PROMETHEUS. — E.V.'

Below it: 'She made it out. Godspeed. — Agnes Colm'
